units.id: mission:Passive-Aggressive Observations|While navigating the skies of this desert world, you notice subsurface readings similar to the planet where you previously encountered a member of the Gegno Vi. It's likely this world is also home to the same or a similar species of large, serpent-like creatures you confronted back then. Eventually, you come across a large Gegno Vi vessel stationed on the surface, though unlike in your prior encounter, the ship isn't sunken into the desert - it has likely landed here recently. A group of Vi warriors are marching out and nearby the vessel, and while they do, two more Gegno ships appear above you.|29|0
units.english: While navigating the skies of this desert world, you notice subsurface readings similar to the planet where you previously encountered a member of the Gegno Vi. It's likely this world is also home to the same or a similar species of large, serpent-like creatures you confronted back then. Eventually, you come across a large Gegno Vi vessel stationed on the surface, though unlike in your prior encounter, the ship isn't sunken into the desert - it has likely landed here recently. A group of Vi warriors are marching out and nearby the vessel, and while they do, two more Gegno ships appear above you.
units.italian: Mentre navighi i cieli di questo mondo desertico, rilevi letture sotterranee simili a quelle del pianeta dove hai incontrato per la prima volta un Gegno Vi. Probabilmente anche questo mondo ospita la stessa specie, o una simile, di grandi creature serpentine che affrontasti allora. Alla fine ti imbatti in un grande vascello Gegno Vi posato sulla superficie; a differenza del tuo incontro precedente, però, la nave non è sprofondata nel deserto: dev'essere atterrata qui di recente. Un gruppo di guerrieri Vi sta uscendo e si sta disponendo lì vicino, e mentre lo fanno compaiono sopra di te altre due navi Gegno.

units.id: mission:Passive-Aggressive Observations|	(Leave.)|31|0
units.english: (Leave.)
units.italian: (Vattene.)

units.id: mission:Passive-Aggressive Observations|	(Continue to observe.)|33|0
units.english: (Continue to observe.)
units.italian: (Continua a osservare.)

units.id: mission:Passive-Aggressive Observations|	The approaching ships descend towards the surface, paying you no attention. One of them is the same model as the one on the ground, likely some type of transport. The other, however, appears to be some sort of interceptor vessel, though it is definitely larger than something like a Sparrow from human space, maybe even the size of a Headhunter.|34|0
units.english: The approaching ships descend towards the surface, paying you no attention. One of them is the same model as the one on the ground, likely some type of transport. The other, however, appears to be some sort of interceptor vessel, though it is definitely larger than something like a Sparrow from human space, maybe even the size of a Headhunter.
units.italian: Le navi in avvicinamento scendono verso la superficie senza dedicarti attenzione. Una è dello stesso modello di quella a terra, probabilmente un trasporto. L'altra invece sembra una specie di intercettore, anche se è decisamente più grande di qualcosa come uno Sparrow dello spazio umano, forse persino delle dimensioni di un Headhunter.

units.id: mission:Passive-Aggressive Observations|	Considering that the planet is home to more of those monsters from before, and the Vi are here in numbers, it might be best you take your leave now before the situation gets out of control again.|35|0
units.english: Considering that the planet is home to more of those monsters from before, and the Vi are here in numbers, it might be best you take your leave now before the situation gets out of control again.
units.italian: Considerando che il pianeta ospita altri di quei mostri di prima, e che i Vi sono qui in forze, forse è meglio andarsene ora prima che la situazione sfugga di nuovo di mano.

units.id: mission:Passive-Aggressive Observations|	(Leave.)|37|0
units.english: (Leave.)
units.italian: (Vattene.)

units.id: mission:Passive-Aggressive Observations|	(Approach the landing zone.)|39|0
units.english: (Approach the landing zone.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati alla zona di atterraggio.)

units.id: mission:Passive-Aggressive Observations|	Throttling your ship forward, you head towards the Vi's landing zone. While the other transport vessel has touched down already, the interceptor, still in the process of landing, suddenly whips around to face you as you approach. Unlike the Scin's warships you confronted a few days ago, which were more reactive to your presence than direct about it, the Vi here are now going out of their way to approach your ship. A moment later, you receive what sounds like an angry hail from the interceptor.|40|0
units.english: Throttling your ship forward, you head towards the Vi's landing zone. While the other transport vessel has touched down already, the interceptor, still in the process of landing, suddenly whips around to face you as you approach. Unlike the Scin's warships you confronted a few days ago, which were more reactive to your presence than direct about it, the Vi here are now going out of their way to approach your ship. A moment later, you receive what sounds like an angry hail from the interceptor.
units.italian: Dai gas e ti dirigi verso la zona di atterraggio dei Vi. Mentre il trasporto ha già toccato terra, l'intercettore, ancora in fase di atterraggio, si gira di colpo verso di te mentre ti avvicini. A differenza delle navi da guerra Scin che hai affrontato pochi giorni fa, più reattive alla tua presenza che dirette, i Vi qui si stanno facendo in quattro per avvicinare la tua nave. Un momento dopo ricevi quella che suona come una chiamata rabbiosa dall'intercettore.

units.id: mission:Passive-Aggressive Observations|	"Tchii ciei escitch tchii iedf teih Voordhte!"|41|0
units.english: "Tchii ciei escitch tchii iedf teih Voordhte!"
units.italian: "Tchii ciei escitch tchii iedf teih Voordhte!"

units.id: mission:Passive-Aggressive Observations|	(Leave now.)|43|0
units.english: (Leave now.)
units.italian: (Vattene subito.)

units.id: mission:Passive-Aggressive Observations|	(Continue.)|44|0
units.english: (Continue.)
units.italian: (Continua.)

units.id: mission:Passive-Aggressive Observations|	You decide it's best to not encroach on the Vi's area any more, as there's no telling what they'd do if you continued to do so. Once you back off, the interceptor briefly jerks forward at you in a vexed manner, continuing to observe you until you've left the area. While the Scin seemed more open to interaction, the Vi are clearly averse to it.|46|0
units.english: You decide it's best to not encroach on the Vi's area any more, as there's no telling what they'd do if you continued to do so. Once you back off, the interceptor briefly jerks forward at you in a vexed manner, continuing to observe you until you've left the area. While the Scin seemed more open to interaction, the Vi are clearly averse to it.
units.italian: Decidi che è meglio non invadere oltre lo spazio dei Vi: non si può sapere cosa farebbero se continuassi. Quando ti allontani, l'intercettore scatta brevemente in avanti verso di te, stizzito, e continua a osservarti finché non hai lasciato la zona. Mentre gli Scin sembravano più aperti all'interazione, i Vi ne sono chiaramente contrari.

units.id: mission:Passive-Aggressive Observations|	You decide to continue flying towards the Vi without heeding their warning. With no hesitation, the interceptor begins to charge at you, and the ships on the surface start preparing for takeoff. Even some of the Vi soldiers on the ground are shouting and gesturing toward your vessel with their weapons. It would seem the Vi are no longer tolerant of your presence.|52|0
units.english: You decide to continue flying towards the Vi without heeding their warning. With no hesitation, the interceptor begins to charge at you, and the ships on the surface start preparing for takeoff. Even some of the Vi soldiers on the ground are shouting and gesturing toward your vessel with their weapons. It would seem the Vi are no longer tolerant of your presence.
units.italian: Decidi di continuare a volare verso i Vi senza dare ascolto al loro avvertimento. Senza esitare, l'intercettore comincia a caricare verso di te e le navi a terra si preparano al decollo. Persino alcuni soldati Vi a terra gridano e gesticolano verso la tua nave con le armi. A quanto pare i Vi non tollerano più la tua presenza.

units.id: mission:Passive-Aggressive Observations|	You decide to withdraw from the area, and the ships continue on their way toward the surface as if you were never there. Regardless of whether or not they could have been hostile, getting mixed up with what may be some sort of military exercise could be dangerous, especially with the Vi.|57|0
units.english: You decide to withdraw from the area, and the ships continue on their way toward the surface as if you were never there. Regardless of whether or not they could have been hostile, getting mixed up with what may be some sort of military exercise could be dangerous, especially with the Vi.
units.italian: Decidi di ritirarti dalla zona, e le navi proseguono verso la superficie come se tu non fossi mai stato lì. Che potessero essere ostili o no, immischiarsi in quella che potrebbe essere un'esercitazione militare può essere pericoloso, soprattutto con i Vi.

units.id: mission:Foreign Spectator I|As you enter the system, you notice that there is both a Vi and a Scin fleet at the center, although neither of them is engaging the other. Instead, they are observing a pair of ships, one from each side, that appear to be challenging one another. Maybe this is some sort of ceremonial event between the Gegno factions. It's probably best not to interfere.|137|0
units.english: As you enter the system, you notice that there is both a Vi and a Scin fleet at the center, although neither of them is engaging the other. Instead, they are observing a pair of ships, one from each side, that appear to be challenging one another. Maybe this is some sort of ceremonial event between the Gegno factions. It's probably best not to interfere.
units.italian: Entrando nel sistema noti al centro una flotta Vi e una Scin, anche se nessuna delle due attacca l'altra. Stanno invece osservando due navi, una per parte, che sembrano sfidarsi. Forse è una sorta di evento cerimoniale tra le fazioni Gegno. Meglio non interferire.

units.id: mission:Brief Bystander|The presence of scattered old recording instruments on the surface of this planet seems to contradict the apparent disinterest with which the Gegno appear to be treating it. Despite its location within the Gegno's home system of Heutesl, the planet is apparently deserted. Still, since this planet isn't strictly controlled by the Gegno, it makes for a convenient place to stop, and they seem to neither notice nor care that you have landed here.|192|0
units.english: The presence of scattered old recording instruments on the surface of this planet seems to contradict the apparent disinterest with which the Gegno appear to be treating it. Despite its location within the Gegno's home system of Heutesl, the planet is apparently deserted. Still, since this planet isn't strictly controlled by the Gegno, it makes for a convenient place to stop, and they seem to neither notice nor care that you have landed here.
units.italian: La presenza di vecchi strumenti di registrazione sparsi sulla superficie di questo pianeta sembra contraddire il disinteresse con cui i Gegno paiono trattarlo. Nonostante si trovi nel sistema natale dei Gegno, Heutesl, il pianeta è apparentemente deserto. Tuttavia, dato che non è sotto stretto controllo Gegno, è un buon posto dove fermarsi, e sembrano non accorgersi né interessarsi del tuo atterraggio.

units.id: mission:Brief Bystander|	However, as you fly around, you notice a small Gegno shuttle parked on the ground. The tan coloration of its hull suggests that it's a civilian craft, but what it's doing here is unknown.|193|0
units.english: However, as you fly around, you notice a small Gegno shuttle parked on the ground. The tan coloration of its hull suggests that it's a civilian craft, but what it's doing here is unknown.
units.italian: Però, mentre voli in cerchio, noti un piccolo shuttle Gegno parcheggiato a terra. Il colore marrone chiaro dello scafo suggerisce che sia un mezzo civile, ma cosa ci faccia qui è ignoto.

units.id: mission:Brief Bystander|	(Investigate.)|195|0
units.english: (Investigate.)
units.italian: (Indaga.)

units.id: mission:Brief Bystander|	(Leave them be.)|197|0
units.english: (Leave them be.)
units.italian: (Lasciali stare.)

units.id: mission:Brief Bystander|	You steer your ship toward the shuttle, and once you approach it, you are able to see a Gegno on the ground fiddling with one of the nearby devices. As you fly closer, they stop their work and return to their shuttle, taking off shortly after. It seems like they weren't interested in any potential interaction with you.|203|0
units.english: You steer your ship toward the shuttle, and once you approach it, you are able to see a Gegno on the ground fiddling with one of the nearby devices. As you fly closer, they stop their work and return to their shuttle, taking off shortly after. It seems like they weren't interested in any potential interaction with you.
units.italian: Dirigi la nave verso lo shuttle e, avvicinandoti, riesci a vedere un Gegno a terra che armeggia con uno dei dispositivi vicini. Mentre ti avvicini, smette di lavorare e torna al suo shuttle, decollando poco dopo. Sembra che non fosse interessato a un eventuale contatto con te.

units.id: mission:Brief Bystander|	Landing beside the satellite, you step out to take a look. The device is indistinguishable from any of the others you have seen so far. Its only notable feature seems to be its advanced age.|204|0
units.english: Landing beside the satellite, you step out to take a look. The device is indistinguishable from any of the others you have seen so far. Its only notable feature seems to be its advanced age.
units.italian: Atterrando accanto al satellite, scendi a dare un'occhiata. Il dispositivo è indistinguibile dagli altri che hai visto finora. L'unico tratto notevole sembra essere la sua età avanzata.

units.id: mission:Scin on Cyife|Nothing is of much interest on this cold, unwelcoming moon in the middle of nowhere. However, there's something about the surface of Cyife that is a bit peculiar. Some of the light refracted through the surface seemingly dissipates or reflects back in strange patterns. Although it appears to be ice, more detailed inspection reveals that small patches of the terrain seem to instead be made of some other type of crystalline material. In the distance is something that truly stands out on this world - a large egg-shaped structure with a green hue to it.|220|0
units.english: Nothing is of much interest on this cold, unwelcoming moon in the middle of nowhere. However, there's something about the surface of Cyife that is a bit peculiar. Some of the light refracted through the surface seemingly dissipates or reflects back in strange patterns. Although it appears to be ice, more detailed inspection reveals that small patches of the terrain seem to instead be made of some other type of crystalline material. In the distance is something that truly stands out on this world - a large egg-shaped structure with a green hue to it.
units.italian: Non c'è niente di molto interessante su questa luna fredda e inospitale in mezzo al nulla. C'è però qualcosa di un po' strano nella superficie di Cyife. Parte della luce rifratta attraverso la superficie sembra dissolversi o riflettersi in schemi strani. Anche se sembra ghiaccio, un esame più attento rivela che piccole chiazze del terreno sono fatte di un altro tipo di materiale cristallino. In lontananza c'è qualcosa che spicca davvero su questo mondo: una grande struttura a forma di uovo con una tonalità verde.

units.id: mission:Scin on Cyife|	Once you get close enough, the oblong object reveals itself to be some sort of large Gegno ship with the coloring of the Scin faction. What it's doing this far away from their home space is a mystery, much like the moon it's stationed on. After a few seconds, it launches into the atmosphere and leaves the moon. There doesn't seem to be anything left where it was parked, nor any trace of what the Scin were doing here to begin with.|228|0
units.english: Once you get close enough, the oblong object reveals itself to be some sort of large Gegno ship with the coloring of the Scin faction. What it's doing this far away from their home space is a mystery, much like the moon it's stationed on. After a few seconds, it launches into the atmosphere and leaves the moon. There doesn't seem to be anything left where it was parked, nor any trace of what the Scin were doing here to begin with.
units.italian: Avvicinandoti abbastanza, l'oggetto oblungo si rivela una grande nave Gegno con i colori della fazione Scin. Cosa ci faccia così lontano dal loro spazio natale è un mistero, come la luna su cui è posata. Dopo qualche secondo si lancia nell'atmosfera e lascia la luna. Non sembra essere rimasto nulla dove era parcheggiata, né traccia di cosa stessero facendo gli Scin qui.

units.id: mission:Scin on Cyife|label|231|0
units.english: saw epidote
units.italian: saw epidote

units.id: mission:Scin on Cyife|	Once you get close enough, the oblong object is revealed to be a large Gegno Scin ship, similar to the one you encountered during an interaction with the Scin a while ago. What it's doing this far away from their home space is a mystery, much like the moon it's stationed on. Or at least, was stationed on, as after a few seconds it launches into the atmosphere and leaves the moon.|232|0
units.english: Once you get close enough, the oblong object is revealed to be a large Gegno Scin ship, similar to the one you encountered during an interaction with the Scin a while ago. What it's doing this far away from their home space is a mystery, much like the moon it's stationed on. Or at least, was stationed on, as after a few seconds it launches into the atmosphere and leaves the moon.
units.italian: Avvicinandoti abbastanza, l'oggetto oblungo si rivela una grande nave Gegno Scin, simile a quella incontrata durante un'interazione con gli Scin tempo fa. Cosa ci faccia così lontano dal loro spazio natale è un mistero, come la luna su cui è posata. O almeno lo era: dopo qualche secondo si lancia nell'atmosfera e lascia la luna.

units.id: mission:Scin on Cyife|label|235|0
units.english: boarded epidote
units.italian: boarded epidote

units.id: mission:Scin on Cyife|	Once you get close enough, the oblong object reveals itself to be one of the Gegno Scin's large research ships, the same kind that you entered during an interaction with the Scin a while ago. It's possible the Scin found the mysteriousness of Cyife worth traveling so far from their home space to investigate. You'll never know for certain as after a few seconds, the ship launches into the atmosphere and disappears into space. They didn't seem to leave anything behind.|236|0
units.english: Once you get close enough, the oblong object reveals itself to be one of the Gegno Scin's large research ships, the same kind that you entered during an interaction with the Scin a while ago. It's possible the Scin found the mysteriousness of Cyife worth traveling so far from their home space to investigate. You'll never know for certain as after a few seconds, the ship launches into the atmosphere and disappears into space. They didn't seem to leave anything behind.
units.italian: Avvicinandoti abbastanza, l'oggetto oblungo si rivela una delle grandi navi da ricerca degli Scin, dello stesso tipo di quella in cui sei entrato durante un'interazione con gli Scin tempo fa. È possibile che gli Scin abbiano trovato il mistero di Cyife abbastanza interessante da viaggiare così lontano dal loro spazio natale. Non lo saprai mai con certezza: dopo qualche secondo la nave si lancia nell'atmosfera e scompare nello spazio. Non sembrano aver lasciato nulla.

units.id: mission:Battle over Zydee|Although this planet is uninhabited, there are more than a few Gegno Scin ships currently parked across the surface. It seems like there's an ongoing operation to continue constructing what infrastructure has been built in the past, and the hard-working Scin pay little to no attention to your visit.|254|0
units.english: Although this planet is uninhabited, there are more than a few Gegno Scin ships currently parked across the surface. It seems like there's an ongoing operation to continue constructing what infrastructure has been built in the past, and the hard-working Scin pay little to no attention to your visit.
units.italian: Per quanto questo pianeta sia disabitato, ci sono più di qualche nave Gegno Scin parcheggiata sulla superficie. Sembra che sia in corso un'operazione per continuare a costruire le infrastrutture già edificate in passato, e gli Scin, instancabili, dedicano al tuo arrivo poca o nessuna attenzione.

units.id: mission:Battle over Zydee|	However, a few moments later, the Scin suddenly start scurrying to their ships. Based on your experiences so far, you haven't gotten close enough to alarm them. They begin taking off one by one in a hurried fashion, but not toward you - the <ship>'s sensors suddenly begin picking up a large Gegno Vi fleet entering the system. It appears that this place is turning into a battlefield, and getting caught up in the middle of it is likely something you should avoid.|255|0
units.english: However, a few moments later, the Scin suddenly start scurrying to their ships. Based on your experiences so far, you haven't gotten close enough to alarm them. They begin taking off one by one in a hurried fashion, but not toward you - the <ship>'s sensors suddenly begin picking up a large Gegno Vi fleet entering the system. It appears that this place is turning into a battlefield, and getting caught up in the middle of it is likely something you should avoid.
units.italian: Pochi momenti dopo, però, gli Scin cominciano all'improvviso a correre verso le loro navi. Per quanto ne sai, non ti sei avvicinato abbastanza da allarmarli. Cominciano a decollare uno dopo l'altro in fretta, ma non verso di te: i sensori della <ship> rilevano all'improvviso una grande flotta Gegno Vi che entra nel sistema. Pare che questo posto stia diventando un campo di battaglia, e finirci in mezzo è probabilmente da evitare.

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|After you go through your post-docking routine and enter the ringworld, you can't help but feel that something is a bit off. Normally, the Quarg here would be swiftly walking about, focused on their duties, but for some reason, there seem to be fewer of them around than usual. Moreover, those you do come across are occasionally having discussions with one another, sometimes looking in your direction even for the slightest moment. What stands out the most is the utter lack of any Gegno in the area you're visiting.|370|0
units.english: After you go through your post-docking routine and enter the ringworld, you can't help but feel that something is a bit off. Normally, the Quarg here would be swiftly walking about, focused on their duties, but for some reason, there seem to be fewer of them around than usual. Moreover, those you do come across are occasionally having discussions with one another, sometimes looking in your direction even for the slightest moment. What stands out the most is the utter lack of any Gegno in the area you're visiting.
units.italian: Dopo le tue procedure post-attracco entri nel mondo ad anello e non puoi fare a meno di sentire che qualcosa non va. Di solito i Quarg qui camminano svelti, concentrati sui loro compiti, ma per qualche ragione intorno ce ne sono meno del solito. In più, quelli che incroci a volte parlano tra loro, e a volte guardano nella tua direzione anche solo per un istante. La cosa che salta più all'occhio è l'assoluta assenza di Gegno nella zona che stai visitando.

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	A few minutes later, while you are making your way through the pristine interior of the ring, you hear a voice call to you from down one of the various branching corridors. Turning around, you recognize the unique attire of the Quarg who has helped you in the past, along with a few others. "Circumstantial greetings once more, <first> <last>. Might we have a significant moment of your attention?"|371|0
units.english: A few minutes later, while you are making your way through the pristine interior of the ring, you hear a voice call to you from down one of the various branching corridors. Turning around, you recognize the unique attire of the Quarg who has helped you in the past, along with a few others. "Circumstantial greetings once more, <first> <last>. Might we have a significant moment of your attention?"
units.italian: Qualche minuto dopo, mentre ti fai strada nell'interno immacolato dell'anello, senti una voce chiamarti da uno dei vari corridoi che si diramano. Voltandoti riconosci l'abbigliamento inconfondibile del Quarg che ti ha aiutato in passato, insieme a qualche altro. "Di nuovo saluti casuali, <first> <last>. Potremmo avere un momento significativo della tua attenzione?"

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	"Sure."|373|0
units.english: "Sure."
units.italian: "Certo."

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	"How long will it take?"|375|0
units.english: "How long will it take?"
units.italian: "Quanto ci vorrà?"

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	"As long as is required, for this matter is of symbolic importance," it says, with a slightly elevated tone.|376|0
units.english: "As long as is required, for this matter is of symbolic importance," it says, with a slightly elevated tone.
units.italian: "Tanto quanto serve, perché questa faccenda ha un'importanza simbolica", dice, con un tono leggermente più alto.

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	You follow the group of Quarg to a smaller discussion room, similar to the one you've previously visited. Or perhaps you've been visiting a different room each time, considering how unfathomably large a ringworld is. Once you sit down, the Quarg from before looks at you for a moment, looks down at the table, then back up to you.|379|0
units.english: You follow the group of Quarg to a smaller discussion room, similar to the one you've previously visited. Or perhaps you've been visiting a different room each time, considering how unfathomably large a ringworld is. Once you sit down, the Quarg from before looks at you for a moment, looks down at the table, then back up to you.
units.italian: Segui il gruppo di Quarg in una sala più piccola, simile a quella che hai visitato prima. O forse ogni volta ne hai visitata una diversa, considerando quanto è incomprensibilmente grande un mondo ad anello. Quando ti siedi, il Quarg di prima ti guarda per un momento, guarda il tavolo, poi torna a guardare te.

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	"Formerly, I have offered suggestions of heedful interplay regarding the Gegno. We have been alerted of a few additional encounters you have experienced, although they seemed minimal in nature. In such cases, it has been generally described that you left in a timely manner, for which we are notably appreciative. However," the Quarg continues, "despite your efforts in recommended cautions, there are some Gegno figures of meaningful standing that expressed frustration in your trivial appearances. They inquired of us as to the possibility of unnecessary reoccurrences."|386|0
units.english: "Formerly, I have offered suggestions of heedful interplay regarding the Gegno. We have been alerted of a few additional encounters you have experienced, although they seemed minimal in nature. In such cases, it has been generally described that you left in a timely manner, for which we are notably appreciative. However," the Quarg continues, "despite your efforts in recommended cautions, there are some Gegno figures of meaningful standing that expressed frustration in your trivial appearances. They inquired of us as to the possibility of unnecessary reoccurrences."
units.italian: "In passato ti ho offerto suggerimenti di cauta interazione riguardo ai Gegno. Ci è stato segnalato un certo numero di ulteriori incontri che hai avuto, anche se sembrano di natura minima. In quei casi è stato riferito che te ne sei andato in tempo, cosa di cui siamo notevolmente grati. Tuttavia", continua il Quarg, "nonostante i tuoi sforzi nelle cautele raccomandate, alcune figure Gegno di rango significativo hanno espresso frustrazione per le tue apparizioni marginali. Ci hanno chiesto della possibilità di inutili recidive."

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	"Why does this frustrate them?"|388|0
units.english: "Why does this frustrate them?"
units.italian: "Perché li frustra?"

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	"I haven't done any harm to them."|390|0
units.english: "I haven't done any harm to them."
units.italian: "Non ho fatto loro alcun male."

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	"It was more coincidental than anything."|392|0
units.english: "It was more coincidental than anything."
units.italian: "È stata più una coincidenza che altro."

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	"I wish to learn more about them."|394|0
units.english: "I wish to learn more about them."
units.italian: "Vorrei saperne di più su di loro."

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	"One need not invoke violence to greatly harm another. However purest intentions may be, even the smallest unbeknownst action may rapidly tumble to one not forseenly desired." The Quarg then ponders for a moment.|398|0
units.english: "One need not invoke violence to greatly harm another. However purest intentions may be, even the smallest unbeknownst action may rapidly tumble to one not forseenly desired." The Quarg then ponders for a moment.
units.italian: "Non serve invocare la violenza per fare molto male a un altro. Per quanto pure possano essere le intenzioni, anche la più piccola azione inconsapevole può rapidamente trasformarsi in una non prevista né desiderata." Il Quarg riflette per un momento.

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	"Even a mere brief coincidence may cause a result not desired, nor foreseen, by the instigator. All living things owe their existence to series of arbitrary coincidences." The Quarg then ponders for a moment.|402|0
units.english: "Even a mere brief coincidence may cause a result not desired, nor foreseen, by the instigator. All living things owe their existence to series of arbitrary coincidences." The Quarg then ponders for a moment.
units.italian: "Persino una mera coincidenza può causare un risultato non voluto né previsto da chi l'ha innescata. Tutte le cose viventi devono la propria esistenza a serie di coincidenze arbitrarie." Il Quarg riflette per un momento.

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	"Not always does the desire to learn lead to pleasant opportunities. The most curious of creatures can easily be harmed when naive to the nature of their interests." The Quarg then ponders for a moment.|406|0
units.english: "Not always does the desire to learn lead to pleasant opportunities. The most curious of creatures can easily be harmed when naive to the nature of their interests." The Quarg then ponders for a moment.
units.italian: "Non sempre il desiderio di sapere porta a occasioni piacevoli. Le creature più curiose possono facilmente farsi male quando sono ignare della natura dei propri interessi." Il Quarg riflette per un momento.

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	"Imagine, if you will, during the substantial conflicts the humans call the Turf Wars, a strange alien came to human space. We Quarg woefully witnessed that hazardous conflict - it was a time of great waste, unfortunate peril, and unsavory distrust among humanity. The Gegno are in a vulnerable state notably comparable to such a time, and introduction of outsiders would not befit the case. The truth remains that we have been contacted by a few Gegno of importance in respect to your past presences, and there has been a show of concern surrounding your unstated intentions." After a brief pause, the Quarg looks to you in a strange manner, and you aren't sure what to make of it. "Though, unexpectedly, a select few times we have also been curiously asked of your origins, an experience we are not strongly familiar with involving the Gegno."|409|0
units.english: "Imagine, if you will, during the substantial conflicts the humans call the Turf Wars, a strange alien came to human space. We Quarg woefully witnessed that hazardous conflict - it was a time of great waste, unfortunate peril, and unsavory distrust among humanity. The Gegno are in a vulnerable state notably comparable to such a time, and introduction of outsiders would not befit the case. The truth remains that we have been contacted by a few Gegno of importance in respect to your past presences, and there has been a show of concern surrounding your unstated intentions." After a brief pause, the Quarg looks to you in a strange manner, and you aren't sure what to make of it. "Though, unexpectedly, a select few times we have also been curiously asked of your origins, an experience we are not strongly familiar with involving the Gegno."
units.italian: "Immagina, se vuoi, che durante i conflitti sostanziali che gli umani chiamano Turf Wars, uno strano alieno giungesse nello spazio umano. Noi Quarg assistemmo con dolore a quel conflitto pericoloso: fu un tempo di grande spreco, di pericolo funesto e di sgradevole diffidenza tra l'umanità. I Gegno sono in uno stato di vulnerabilità notevolmente paragonabile a quel tempo, e l'introduzione di estranei non si addirebbe al caso. La verità è che alcuni Gegno di riguardo ci hanno contattato in merito alle tue passate presenze, e c'è stata una manifestazione di preoccupazione per le tue intenzioni non dichiarate." Dopo una breve pausa il Quarg ti guarda in modo strano, e non sai cosa pensare. "Tuttavia, inaspettatamente, in alcune rare occasioni ci è stato chiesto con curiosità delle tue origini, un'esperienza che non ci è molto familiare con i Gegno."

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	The Quarg leaves its chair and motions you to do the same.|410|0
units.english: The Quarg leaves its chair and motions you to do the same.
units.italian: Il Quarg lascia la sedia e ti fa cenno di fare lo stesso.

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	(Stand up.)|412|0
units.english: (Stand up.)
units.italian: (Alzati.)

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	"Our best of recommendations to you is to avoid further contact in the coming future. Meanwhile, we shall attempt a most careful negotiation with their hierarchy to come to terms of a ground of acceptance for your presence. Should we find commonality, you will receive communication from one of the title 'Adrauni,' as has been bestowed upon me."|414|0
units.english: "Our best of recommendations to you is to avoid further contact in the coming future. Meanwhile, we shall attempt a most careful negotiation with their hierarchy to come to terms of a ground of acceptance for your presence. Should we find commonality, you will receive communication from one of the title 'Adrauni,' as has been bestowed upon me."
units.italian: "La nostra migliore raccomandazione è di evitare ulteriori contatti nel prossimo futuro. Intanto tenteremo una negoziazione molto attenta con la loro gerarchia per trovare i termini di una base di accettazione della tua presenza. Se troveremo un'intesa, riceverai comunicazione da uno con il titolo di 'Adrauni', come è stato conferito a me."

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	The rest of the Quarg, who have been listening to the conversation attentively the whole time, begin to escort you out of the room. If the Gegno are willing to go as far as to contact the Quarg about your appearances, then this is truly an important matter to them. For the time being, it's probably best to allow the Quarg to find some kind of resolution with the Gegno while you keep your distance.|415|0
units.english: The rest of the Quarg, who have been listening to the conversation attentively the whole time, begin to escort you out of the room. If the Gegno are willing to go as far as to contact the Quarg about your appearances, then this is truly an important matter to them. For the time being, it's probably best to allow the Quarg to find some kind of resolution with the Gegno while you keep your distance.
units.italian: Il resto dei Quarg, che hanno ascoltato la conversazione con attenzione per tutto il tempo, comincia a scortarti fuori dalla stanza. Se i Gegno sono disposti ad arrivare a contattare i Quarg per le tue apparizioni, allora è davvero una faccenda importante per loro. Per il momento è probabilmente meglio lasciare che i Quarg trovino una qualche soluzione con i Gegno mentre tu te ne stai a distanza.

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|label|419|0
units.english: negative rep
units.italian: negative rep

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	"Formerly, I have offered suggestions of heedful interplay regarding the Gegno. However, we are increasingly aware of correlative happenings upon them involving yourself. It would seem consequential events have indeed occurred. Not often previously were we approached by Gegno, but on a few notable occasions now have meaningful figures sought us out for inquiry - most notably due to violent circumstances." The Quarg stares at you for an extended period of time, waiting for some kind of answer.|420|0
units.english: "Formerly, I have offered suggestions of heedful interplay regarding the Gegno. However, we are increasingly aware of correlative happenings upon them involving yourself. It would seem consequential events have indeed occurred. Not often previously were we approached by Gegno, but on a few notable occasions now have meaningful figures sought us out for inquiry - most notably due to violent circumstances." The Quarg stares at you for an extended period of time, waiting for some kind of answer.
units.italian: "In passato ti ho offerto suggerimenti di cauta interazione riguardo ai Gegno. Tuttavia siamo sempre più consapevoli di avvenimenti correlati a loro che ti riguardano. Pare che eventi conseguenti si siano davvero verificati. Non spesso in passato fummo avvicinati dai Gegno, ma in alcune notevoli occasioni figure di rilievo ci hanno cercato per informarsi, soprattutto a causa di circostanze violente." Il Quarg ti fissa a lungo, aspettando una qualche risposta.

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	"They attacked me first."|422|0
units.english: "They attacked me first."
units.italian: "Mi hanno attaccato loro per primi."

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	"I wanted to get their attention."|423|0
units.english: "I wanted to get their attention."
units.italian: "Volevo attirare la loro attenzione."

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	"Violence happens all the time in human space, but the Quarg don't seem interested in it."|425|0
units.english: "Violence happens all the time in human space, but the Quarg don't seem interested in it."
units.italian: "La violenza accade continuamente nello spazio umano, ma i Quarg non sembrano interessati."

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	The Quarg continues to look at you for a while longer before answering. "Based on some principles, I may see reason for them to be... inclined... to do such. However, to do so in this case would not align with their elder's interests, nor would any fabrications." The Quarg blinks at you, then ponders for a moment.|428|0
units.english: The Quarg continues to look at you for a while longer before answering. "Based on some principles, I may see reason for them to be... inclined... to do such. However, to do so in this case would not align with their elder's interests, nor would any fabrications." The Quarg blinks at you, then ponders for a moment.
units.italian: Il Quarg continua a guardarti per un po' prima di rispondere. "In base ad alcuni principi, posso vedere ragioni perché essi siano... inclini... a farlo. Tuttavia farlo in questo caso non si allineerebbe agli interessi dei loro anziani, né lo farebbe alcuna fabbricazione." Il Quarg sbatte le palpebre, poi riflette per un momento.

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	The Quarg blinks. "And you found a suitable solution to your... problem... by instigating unprovoked hostilities?" The Quarg then continues to stare at you in what you presume to be a judgemental manner for an awkward amount of time, before looking away to ponder to itself.|432|0
units.english: The Quarg blinks. "And you found a suitable solution to your... problem... by instigating unprovoked hostilities?" The Quarg then continues to stare at you in what you presume to be a judgemental manner for an awkward amount of time, before looking away to ponder to itself.
units.italian: Il Quarg sbatte le palpebre. "E hai trovato una soluzione adeguata al tuo... problema... scatenando ostilità non provocate?" Poi continua a fissarti in quella che supponi essere un'aria giudicante per un tempo imbarazzante, prima di distogliere lo sguardo per riflettere tra sé.

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	The Quarg takes a long moment to ponder your statement, as if it wasn't expecting such a response. "Indeed, it is known that conflict is commonly natural amongst you quarrelsome humans. But this matter is of another sort." The Quarg then thinks to itself again for a little longer.|436|0
units.english: The Quarg takes a long moment to ponder your statement, as if it wasn't expecting such a response. "Indeed, it is known that conflict is commonly natural amongst you quarrelsome humans. But this matter is of another sort." The Quarg then thinks to itself again for a little longer.
units.italian: Il Quarg prende un lungo momento per riflettere sulla tua affermazione, come se non si aspettasse una risposta simile. "Certo, è noto che il conflitto sia comunemente naturale tra voi litigiosi umani. Ma questa faccenda è di altro genere." Poi pensa di nuovo tra sé per un po'.

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	"Imagine, if you will, during the substantial conflicts the humans call the Turf Wars, a hostile alien came to human space. We Quarg woefully witnessed that hazardous conflict - it was a time of great waste, unfortunate peril, and unsavory distrust among humanity. The Gegno are in a vulnerable state notably comparable to such a time, and introduction of even more hostilities would not befit the case, especially of those from the outside. We have been contacted by numerous Gegno members of high standing and wish for this to be a matter only of further strict cautionaries, but regrettably, the Gegno believe it a matter beyond attentiveness." The Quarg leaves its chair and motions you to do the same.|440|0
units.english: "Imagine, if you will, during the substantial conflicts the humans call the Turf Wars, a hostile alien came to human space. We Quarg woefully witnessed that hazardous conflict - it was a time of great waste, unfortunate peril, and unsavory distrust among humanity. The Gegno are in a vulnerable state notably comparable to such a time, and introduction of even more hostilities would not befit the case, especially of those from the outside. We have been contacted by numerous Gegno members of high standing and wish for this to be a matter only of further strict cautionaries, but regrettably, the Gegno believe it a matter beyond attentiveness." The Quarg leaves its chair and motions you to do the same.
units.italian: "Immagina, se vuoi, che durante i conflitti sostanziali che gli umani chiamano Turf Wars, un alieno ostile giungesse nello spazio umano. Noi Quarg assistemmo con dolore a quel conflitto pericoloso: fu un tempo di grande spreco, di pericolo funesto e di sgradevole diffidenza tra l'umanità. I Gegno sono in uno stato di vulnerabilità notevolmente paragonabile a quel tempo, e l'introduzione di ancor più ostilità non si addirebbe al caso, soprattutto da parte di estranei. Siamo stati contattati da numerosi Gegno di alto rango e desideriamo che questa resti una faccenda di sole cautele più severe, ma purtroppo i Gegno la ritengono una questione che va oltre l'attenzione." Il Quarg lascia la sedia e ti fa cenno di fare lo stesso.

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	(Stand up.)|442|0
units.english: (Stand up.)
units.italian: (Alzati.)

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	"You are recommended for departure from Gegno space as of this decisive moment. Meanwhile, we shall attempt a most careful negotiation with their hierarchy to come to terms of an acceptable toleration of sorts. Should we find commonality, you will receive communication from one of the title 'Adrauni,' as has been bestowed upon me."|444|0
units.english: "You are recommended for departure from Gegno space as of this decisive moment. Meanwhile, we shall attempt a most careful negotiation with their hierarchy to come to terms of an acceptable toleration of sorts. Should we find commonality, you will receive communication from one of the title 'Adrauni,' as has been bestowed upon me."
units.italian: "Ti si raccomanda di lasciare lo spazio Gegno da questo momento decisivo. Intanto tenteremo una negoziazione molto attenta con la loro gerarchia per arrivare ai termini di una tolleranza accettabile. Se troveremo un'intesa, riceverai comunicazione da uno con il titolo di 'Adrauni', come è stato conferito a me."

units.id: mission:Gegno Suspicions|	As the rest of the Quarg escort you out of the room, the Quarg named 'Adrauni' addresses you one last time. "Do avoid any further violent tendencies, Captain." If the Gegno are willing to go as far as to contact the Quarg, then this is truly an important matter to them. For the time being, it's probably best to listen to the Quarg's warnings this time around and leave Gegno space until some kind of resolution is found, if at all.|445|0
units.english: As the rest of the Quarg escort you out of the room, the Quarg named 'Adrauni' addresses you one last time. "Do avoid any further violent tendencies, Captain." If the Gegno are willing to go as far as to contact the Quarg, then this is truly an important matter to them. For the time being, it's probably best to listen to the Quarg's warnings this time around and leave Gegno space until some kind of resolution is found, if at all.
units.italian: Mentre il resto dei Quarg ti scorta fuori dalla stanza, il Quarg di nome 'Adrauni' ti si rivolge un'ultima volta. "Eviti qualsiasi ulteriore tendenza violenta, capitano." Se i Gegno sono disposti ad arrivare a contattare i Quarg, allora è davvero una faccenda importante per loro. Per il momento è probabilmente meglio ascoltare gli avvertimenti dei Quarg, questa volta, e lasciare lo spazio Gegno finché non si trovi una soluzione, sempre che ci sia.

units.id: mission:Return to Giaru Gegno|description|571|0
units.english: The Quarg known as Adrauni has summoned you back to <destination>.
units.italian: Il Quarg noto come Adrauni ti ha convocato di nuovo su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Return to Giaru Gegno|dialog|582|0
units.english: There is an incoming message on your communications device. "Greetings, human <first> <last>. This message is from the Quarg that is named Adrauni. Return to <planet> at the first opportunity given to you."
units.italian: C'è un messaggio in arrivo sul tuo dispositivo di comunicazione. "Saluti, umano <first> <last>. Questo messaggio viene dal Quarg di nome Adrauni. Torna su <planet> alla prima occasione che ti è data."

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|name|591|0
units.english: Summons from the Gegno
units.italian: Convocazione dei Gegno

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|description|592|0
units.english: Present yourself to the Gegno on <destination> within the next 8 days, where you will find out if you have any future with them.
units.italian: Presentati ai Gegno su <destination> entro i prossimi 8 giorni, dove scoprirai se hai un futuro con loro.

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|Once you land on the ringworld, you are greeted by a small group of Quarg who quickly motion you to follow them. They escort you through various halls of the ring, which still appear to lack the presence of any Gegno. Down at the end of the next corridor, you see Adrauni waiting for you, though beside it is a Gegno in some form of strange attire. Once you meet up with them, the other Quarg head off in a different direction, and Adrauni begins walking down another hallway. "Please, indulge in accompanying us."|610|0
units.english: Once you land on the ringworld, you are greeted by a small group of Quarg who quickly motion you to follow them. They escort you through various halls of the ring, which still appear to lack the presence of any Gegno. Down at the end of the next corridor, you see Adrauni waiting for you, though beside it is a Gegno in some form of strange attire. Once you meet up with them, the other Quarg head off in a different direction, and Adrauni begins walking down another hallway. "Please, indulge in accompanying us."
units.italian: Appena atterri sul mondo ad anello, ti accoglie un piccolo gruppo di Quarg che ti fa subito cenno di seguirli. Ti scortano attraverso varie sale dell'anello, che sembrano ancora prive di qualsiasi Gegno. In fondo al corridoio successivo vedi Adrauni che ti aspetta, e accanto a lui un Gegno con un abbigliamento di forma strana. Quando li raggiungi, gli altri Quarg si dirigono altrove e Adrauni comincia a camminare lungo un altro corridoio. "Ti prego, concediti di accompagnarci."

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|	As you follow them, Adrauni begins to speak while holding out one arm. "If you may, as humans say, humor me, what do you suspect was the result of my negotiations with the Gegno?"|611|0
units.english: As you follow them, Adrauni begins to speak while holding out one arm. "If you may, as humans say, humor me, what do you suspect was the result of my negotiations with the Gegno?"
units.italian: Mentre li segui, Adrauni comincia a parlare tendendo un braccio. "Se puoi, come dicono gli umani, assecondami: cosa sospetti sia stato il risultato delle mie negoziazioni con i Gegno?"

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|	"That they will accept me?"|613|0
units.english: "That they will accept me?"
units.italian: "Che mi accetteranno?"

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|	"That they want nothing to do with me?"|614|0
units.english: "That they want nothing to do with me?"
units.italian: "Che non vogliono avere niente a che fare con me?"

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|	"I don't know."|616|0
units.english: "I don't know."
units.italian: "Non lo so."

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|	After a brief delay, Adrauni turns to the Gegno, mutters something in their language, then responds to you. "I see. And what do you propose is the reasoning for that?"|621|0
units.english: After a brief delay, Adrauni turns to the Gegno, mutters something in their language, then responds to you. "I see. And what do you propose is the reasoning for that?"
units.italian: Dopo una breve pausa Adrauni si volta verso il Gegno, mormora qualcosa nella loro lingua, poi ti risponde. "Capisco. E quale proponi che sia la ragione?"

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|	"I've helped them before, and I could help them now."|623|0
units.english: "I've helped them before, and I could help them now."
units.italian: "Li ho aiutati prima, e potrei aiutarli ora."

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|	"I figured you could convince them."|624|0
units.english: "I figured you could convince them."
units.italian: "Pensavo che avreste potuto convincerli."

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|	"I don't know."|626|0
units.english: "I don't know."
units.italian: "Non lo so."

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|	Adrauni ponders for a few moments as you continue walking through the impeccable interior of the ringworld. "That is a rather human response. However, do not conflate your value in assistance with theirs. Even should you provide beneficial assistance to the Gegno, a beneficent response in return is not necessitated. You have heeded my warnings at this juncture, yet you simply are doing what the Gegno desired from the beginning, and that is leaving them alone."|629|0
units.english: Adrauni ponders for a few moments as you continue walking through the impeccable interior of the ringworld. "That is a rather human response. However, do not conflate your value in assistance with theirs. Even should you provide beneficial assistance to the Gegno, a beneficent response in return is not necessitated. You have heeded my warnings at this juncture, yet you simply are doing what the Gegno desired from the beginning, and that is leaving them alone."
units.italian: Adrauni riflette per qualche momento mentre continuate a camminare nell'interno impeccabile del mondo ad anello. "È una risposta piuttosto umana. Tuttavia non confondere il tuo valore nell'assistenza con il loro. Anche se fornissi ai Gegno un aiuto benefico, una risposta benevola in cambio non è necessaria. A questo punto hai dato ascolto ai miei avvertimenti, eppure stai semplicemente facendo ciò che i Gegno desideravano dall'inizio: lasciarli stare."

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|	"Maybe it's better I do leave them alone."|631|0
units.english: "Maybe it's better I do leave them alone."
units.italian: "Forse è meglio che li lasci stare."

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|	"There must be something I can do."|633|0
units.english: "There must be something I can do."
units.italian: "Deve esserci qualcosa che posso fare."

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|label|636|0
units.english: convince
units.italian: convince

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|	Adrauni gives you a slight glare while continuing through the ringworld. "Do you not recall my prior mention of us Quarg having attempted such desired persuasions? It is not within our ability to convince the Gegno of anything. They are greatly devoted to their own, and will go beyond any boundary to oppose counsel, even by us Quarg."|637|0
units.english: Adrauni gives you a slight glare while continuing through the ringworld. "Do you not recall my prior mention of us Quarg having attempted such desired persuasions? It is not within our ability to convince the Gegno of anything. They are greatly devoted to their own, and will go beyond any boundary to oppose counsel, even by us Quarg."
units.italian: Adrauni ti lancia un'occhiataccia continuando attraverso il mondo ad anello. "Non ricordi la mia precedente menzione che noi Quarg abbiamo tentato simili persuasioni? Non è in nostra capacità convincere i Gegno di nulla. Sono molto devoti ai propri, e supererebbero ogni confine per opporsi a un consiglio, anche da noi Quarg."

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|	"Maybe it's better I do leave them alone."|639|0
units.english: "Maybe it's better I do leave them alone."
units.italian: "Forse è meglio che li lasci stare."

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|	"There must be something I can do."|641|0
units.english: "There must be something I can do."
units.italian: "Deve esserci qualcosa che posso fare."

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|label|644|0
units.english: deny me
units.italian: deny me

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|	After a brief delay, Adrauni turns to the Gegno, mutters something in their language, then responds to you. "I see. And what do you propose is the reasoning for that?"|647|0
units.english: After a brief delay, Adrauni turns to the Gegno, mutters something in their language, then responds to you. "I see. And what do you propose is the reasoning for that?"
units.italian: Dopo una breve pausa Adrauni si volta verso il Gegno, mormora qualcosa nella loro lingua, poi ti risponde. "Capisco. E quale proponi che sia la ragione?"

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|	"The way they act around me."|649|0
units.english: "The way they act around me."
units.italian: "Per come si comportano con me."

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|	"From what you've told me before."|650|0
units.english: "From what you've told me before."
units.italian: "Da quello che mi hai detto prima."

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|	"I don't know."|652|0
units.english: "I don't know."
units.italian: "Non lo so."

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|	"Indeed, the Gegno are wary of you, who lack caution." A few seconds pass, and Adrauni gives a strange look towards the Gegno. You aren't sure what it's thinking. The Gegno seems to ask a question in their language, but receives no response. Adrauni pauses a while longer before speaking again. "Despite that, you have found yourself in precarious situations we have not. We as a species embraced contact with the Gegno; however, you remain the only human here. Perhaps therein lies a notable implication of distinction."|655|0
units.english: "Indeed, the Gegno are wary of you, who lack caution." A few seconds pass, and Adrauni gives a strange look towards the Gegno. You aren't sure what it's thinking. The Gegno seems to ask a question in their language, but receives no response. Adrauni pauses a while longer before speaking again. "Despite that, you have found yourself in precarious situations we have not. We as a species embraced contact with the Gegno; however, you remain the only human here. Perhaps therein lies a notable implication of distinction."
units.italian: "Certo, i Gegno sono diffidenti verso di te, che manchi di cautela." Passano alcuni secondi, e Adrauni lancia uno sguardo strano verso il Gegno. Non sai cosa stia pensando. units.italian: Camminate in silenzio per un periodo imbarazzante. La strana architettura del mondo ad anello ti rassicura poco; hai la sensazione di aver già percorso lo stesso tratto diverse volte. Qualche momento dopo cominci a seguire Adrauni e il Gegno in quella che sembra una sezione diversa, anche se stranamente più ampia delle precedenti. Prima che tu possa fare altre domande, Adrauni risponde finalmente. "È evidente che tu possa comprendere qualcosa della tua fragile situazione. Non è più ciò che io, anzi, i Quarg, possono fare per te. È ciò che tu puoi fare per te stesso."

units.english: Adrauni speaks to the Gegno once more for an extended period of time. "Yes, it may be that your timely departure is the most favorable outcome in this affair." units.italian: Adrauni parla ancora a lungo con il Gegno. La strana architettura del mondo ad anello ti rassicura poco; hai la sensazione di aver già percorso lo stesso tratto diverse volte. Qualche momento dopo cominci a seguire Adrauni e il Gegno in quella che sembra una sezione diversa, anche se stranamente più ampia delle precedenti. "Sì, può essere che la tua partenza tempestiva sia l'esito più favorevole in questa faccenda." Segue un lungo silenzio imbarazzante, alla fine del quale Adrauni si ferma brevemente, sempre rivolto avanti, incrociando le braccia dietro la schiena. "Anche se tu ed io immaginiamo che sia... improbabile."

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|	The Gegno leaves the two of you upon the entrance to a separate hallway, and you follow Adrauni to one last stop. You are at the end of your seemingly long trip through the ringworld, finding yourself back where you started - the docking facility where your ship is stationed. Although it felt like a dizzying maze to follow Adrauni around back to here, you can't help but imagine how much more confusing it would be to explore the entirety of a ringworld, considering that was only several minutes worth. Adrauni stops and turns to you, slightly lowering itself to speak closer to your own height. "You must seek audience on your own, tenacious, behalf. Visit the Gegno homeworld of Dueyu Eitch, present yourself in a manner that you desire to be perceived. Only then will you find your desired answer."|701|0

units.italian: Il Gegno vi lascia all'ingresso di un corridoio separato, e tu segui Adrauni fino a un'ultima tappa. Sei alla fine del tuo lungo viaggio attraverso il mondo ad anello e ti ritrovi dove hai cominciato: la struttura di attracco dove è posata la tua nave. Anche se seguire Adrauni fin qui è sembrato un labirinto vertiginoso, non puoi fare a meno di immaginare quanto sarebbe più confuso esplorare un intero mondo ad anello, considerando che questo era solo qualche minuto. Adrauni si ferma e si volta verso di te, abbassandosi un poco per parlarti all'altezza dei tuoi occhi. "Devi cercare udienza per conto tuo, tenace. Visita il mondo natale dei Gegno, Dueyu Eitch, e presentati nel modo in cui desideri essere percepito. Solo allora troverai la risposta che cerchi."

Con te forse sarebbe così, ma con l'umanità ansiosa certamente no." Uno degli altri Quarg nella stanza dice qualcosa ad Adrauni, che risponde con una conversazione nella propria lingua.

units.english: "Indeed, you do not. To tolerate is to authorize unrestricted occurrence despite undesired preface. In this lies not the Gegno's interest, as once I have said before." It looks up in thought for several moments. "Perhaps in your naive judgment I am mistaken. Humans tolerate their own undesirables, those who have come to be known as corsairs. Portions of your species permit their tiresome actions, while others do not. Be that as it may, suppose a species other than humanity begins similar agitation. I would presume the case to be different." Adrauni then begins a conversation with the other Quarg in the room.
units.italian: "Certo che no. Tollerare significa autorizzare un accadimento senza restrizioni nonostante una premessa indesiderata. In questo non sta l'interesse dei Gegno, come ho già detto una volta." Guarda in alto pensieroso per diversi momenti. "Forse nel tuo giudizio ingenuo mi sbaglio. Gli umani tollerano i propri indesiderabili, quelli divenuti noti come corsari. Parti della tua specie ne permettono le azioni moleste, altre no. Ciò nonostante, supponi che una specie diversa dall'umanità cominci un'agitazione simile. Presumerei che il caso sarebbe diverso." Adrauni comincia allora una conversazione con gli altri Quarg nella stanza.

units.english: "It would be evidently so, given that those of the Vi themselves have brazenly entered our ring. I had the slightest hope you understood my preachings of nonviolence, as I believe there to be benefit from optimistic aspirations in younger species, but ultimately my hopes are proven unfounded." units.italian: "Evidentemente sì, visto che quelli dei Vi sono entrati sfrontatamente nel nostro anello. Avevo la minima speranza che tu avessi compreso i miei ammonimenti sulla non violenza, perché credo che ci sia beneficio nelle aspirazioni ottimistiche delle specie più giovani, ma alla fine le mie speranze si sono rivelate infondate." Alcuni degli altri Quarg nella stanza si rivolgono bruscamente ad Adrauni come se tu non fossi presente e cominciano un lungo periodo di dibattito, punteggiato ogni tanto da occhiatacce nella tua direzione.

units.english: "Yes, I believe that to be a common theme in this extraneous situation. It is quite a dangerous practice to commit an act before knowledge, as we Quarg have been advising you impulsive humans for many years. In our discussions with you, evident it is that this has proven to be true. However, the great bounds stepped beyond here go beyond what we are able to accommodate." Adrauni then changes its expression slightly, glowering at you again. "Particularly after continual warnings prior." One of the other Quarg in the room says something to Adrauni, to which it begins a conversation in its own language.
units.italian: "Sì, credo che sia un tema ricorrente in questa situazione superflua. È una pratica piuttosto pericolosa compiere un atto prima della conoscenza, come noi Quarg consigliamo da molti anni a voi impulsivi umani. Nelle nostre discussioni con voi è evidente che questo si è dimostrato vero. Tuttavia i grandi limiti superati qui vanno oltre ciò che possiamo permetterci di accogliere." Adrauni cambia leggermente espressione, fulminandoti di nuovo. "Soprattutto dopo continui avvertimenti precedenti." Uno degli altri Quarg nella stanza dice qualcosa ad Adrauni, che avvia una conversazione nella propria lingua.

units.italian: Restate seduti in silenzio per un tempo scomodo, durante il quale persino i Quarg non si parlano. La strana struttura e le luci brillanti della stanza ti rassicurano poco mentre i Quarg riflettono tra sé. Qualche momento dopo ricominciano a parlare tra loro, ma non hai occasione di dire una parola. Dopo diversi altri minuti di discussione e sguardi strani, gli altri Quarg si alzano e ti affiancano da entrambi i lati, mentre Adrauni finalmente ti si rivolge di nuovo. "Purtroppo, a questo punto degli eventi, né io né i Quarg possiamo darti una risposta alla tua richiesta. Siamo concordi nella nostra ferma opposizione a ulteriori interazioni tra te e i Gegno." Poi fa quello che pensi sarebbe l'equivalente Quarg di un sospiro.

units.id: mission:Gegno Anticipation|	The door opens behind you, and the Quarg motion you to follow them once more, escorting you out of the room and back to the hangar your ship is parked in. There seem to be a few more Quarg walking the corridors than usual, some stationed among various entrances. You can't help but remember that this is only one small section of the ring, making the rest of it seem even more impossibly large and filled with Quarg. Once you return to the hangar, you're greeted by the sight of the Vi warriors being blocked off by a larger group of Quarg, although there doesn't seem to be any intentions of hostility, nor conversation, from either side. Adrauni then stops in front of you. "It is no longer in our jurisdiction to assist you in this. However, if you indeed continue to pursue this desire to associate with the Gegno, you must seek audience yourself. units.italian: La porta si apre alle tue spalle e i Quarg ti fanno cenno di seguirli di nuovo, scortandoti fuori dalla stanza e riportandoti all'hangar dove è parcheggiata la tua nave. Sembrano esserci più Quarg del solito nei corridoi, alcuni di stanza presso vari ingressi. Non puoi fare a meno di ricordare che questa è solo una piccola parte dell'anello, il che rende il resto ancora più incomprensibilmente grande e pieno di Quarg. Tornato all'hangar, trovi la vista dei guerrieri Vi bloccati da un gruppo più numeroso di Quarg, anche se non sembrano esserci intenzioni ostili, né conversazione, da nessuna delle due parti. Adrauni si ferma allora davanti a te. "Non è più nella nostra giurisdizione assisterti in questo. Tuttavia, se davvero continui a perseguire questo desiderio di avere a che fare con i Gegno, devi cercare udienza da solo. Visita il mondo natale dei Gegno, Dueyu Eitch, e presentati nel modo in cui desideri essere percepito. Solo allora troverai risposta ai tuoi capricci."

units.italian: "Quelli dei Vi non rappresentano quelli dei Gegno, cioè di un'intera specie. I Vi qui presenti sono solo di una famiglia, e di gruppi simili ce ne sono molti." La cultura Vi non designa una famiglia solo per discendenza o familiarità."

units.english: "Although your actions thus far are in dissatisfaction, I aspire for future decisions being made to befit the wise on your journey ahead. I wish you an educational journey, <first> <last>." Adrauni gives you a lengthy bow, then leaves the hangar. You get the feeling that this might have been the last time you meet with it. units.italian: "Per quanto le tue azioni finora siano insoddisfacenti, aspiro a che le decisioni future si addicano ai saggi nel cammino che ti attende. Ti auguro un viaggio istruttivo, <first> <last>." Adrauni ti fa un lungo inchino, poi lascia l'hangar. Hai la sensazione che questa possa essere stata l'ultima volta che lo incontri. Mentre torni alla nave, i guerrieri Vi continuano a osservare da lontano, ma i Quarg li bloccano con fermezza. Tocca a te capire se i Gegno ti tollereranno ancora.
